verdict.rationale: Smooth provides documented SDK/API methods (task execution, session workflows, structured outputs, custom tools, proxies) and an llms.txt docs index plus a CLI, showing a documented programmatic interface for AI-native use. However, no formal OpenAPI/REST spec was found (404s on all standard paths), and there is no independent corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/REST spec, independent/hands-on verification of API completeness and stability.
